Ratsputin's Icy Sword of Whisker Power
Piece:  Weapon
Type:  One-handed Sword
Class:  Fighter
Damage:  varies with item level

Ratsputin's Icy Sword of Whisker Power is a fighter one-handed sword.

This item is soulbound.

This rainbow is specific to Ratsputin's lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Agility
  • + Endurance
  • + Intellect
  • + Ice Damage
  • + Slashing Damage
  • + Total Health
  • + % Melee Critical Chance
  • + Health Steal

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
